Hi there! I need some help with a few exchanges and a cancellation. I recently placed an order that included a bicycle, a jigsaw puzzle, and a camera. I’d like to exchange the bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and swap the jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces—if possible, I’d prefer an animal theme over art. Also, I want to exchange the camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but keep the other features the same.

And in a different order, I’d like to cancel the skateboard. Can you help me with all of that?
I actually don’t remember which email I used, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my orders!

I’m not totally sure which order numbers they’re in, but I believe the bicycle, jigsaw puzzle, and camera were all in the same order, and the skateboard was in a separate one. If you could look up my recent orders and confirm, that would be great—just to make sure we’re changing the right items. Thanks!

Yes, that all sounds correct! Please go ahead with those actions. And just a heads up—if you need to process any refunds or payments, I’d prefer to use my other card on file instead of the one I originally used. Let me know if you need anything else from me before you start!

Thanks for the details! Here’s what I’d like to do:

- For the puzzle, I’ll go with the 1500-piece animal-themed one.
- The large, red, mountain bike is fine for the exchange.
- The 20MP, 3x zoom, SD card camera works for me.
- And yes, please cancel the skateboard and use my Mastercard ending in 8484 for any refunds or payments.

Please go ahead with these changes! Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Great, thank you for confirming everything and for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions. That’s all I needed for now. Have a good day! 

###STOP###
